title: EngramContainmentAdmissionScope::drop double-panics on a poisoned StateInner during unwind
outcome: Unwinding a failure while holding StateInner preserves the original error without a second panic from the containment admission guard; exact admission ownership remains safe.
acceptance: A deterministic regression exercises the containment admission guard during unwinding after StateInner is poisoned, preserves the original failure, and does not abort the process.
The normal non-panicking path preserves exact-owner admission cleanup and does not clear a different owner's state; the fix follows existing panic-safety ownership patterns.
